verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26456226 from Boise Semiconductor to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318655 (dated 2026-04-23): 8,000 pcs of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5 at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-05-26. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: The terms contradict themselves: EXW Boise and 'DDP is not agreed' are stated, but the text also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays for freight, so this charge-through needs clarifying.
The document has no issue date of its own; only the order date 2026-04-23 is given.
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
Single line item; no total price is shown.
The quantity has no unit of measure.
